segments.comment: read.c seffect_amnesia() compares the first four bytes of plname with "Maud" by strncmpi() and, on a match, prints the inward-turning message without drawing rn2(2). The nethackrc name is 29 UTF-8 bytes and starts with Maud followed by a two-byte letter. Seeds 3305001-3307000 were scanned with the port for an uncursed scroll of amnesia on the floor of the starting room; this seed has one two squares east and one south of the hero, who picks it up and reads it. The clock and name were chosen before the scan.
